summary: Tested Material Order Reminders feature - all backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. Materials can be added with order_reminder_date, marked as ordered via checkbox, and the Dashboard shows 'Materialen Bestellen!' widget for materials due for ordering.
seed_data_creation: Created test materials in project 'Zinio & Amy' (PROJ-8DC83A0F) with order_reminder_date set to today and yesterday for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Material Order Reminders feature is fully functional. Materials can be added with order_reminder_date field in the Planning tab. Dashboard shows 'Materialen Bestellen!' widget for materials where order_reminder_date <= today and is_ordered=false. Clicking 'Besteld' button marks material as ordered and removes it from the widget.

POST /api/projects/{id}/scheduled-days/{.details: Materials can be added with order_reminder_date field. Field is stored correctly and returned in response.

PUT /api/projects/{id}/scheduled-days/{p.details: Materials can be marked as ordered (is_ordered=true) or unmarked (is_ordered=false). Status persists correctly.

GET /api/dashboard/material-reminders.details: Returns materials where order_reminder_date <= today and is_ordered=false. Includes days_overdue count. Excludes ordered materials and future-dated materials.

Frontend: Planning tab - Besteldatum fie.details: Material form in Planning tab shows 'Besteldatum' date input field. Materials can be added with order date.

Frontend: Planning tab - Order date disp.details: Materials in list show order date badge '📅 Bestellen: [date]' with red/amber styling based on urgency.

Frontend: Planning tab - Checkbox to mar.details: Checkbox next to each material allows marking as ordered. Shows '✓ Besteld' badge when checked.

Frontend: Dashboard - Materialen Bestell.details: Dashboard shows red-bordered widget with materials due for ordering. Shows project name, work period, material details, and 'X dag(en) te laat!' badge for overdue items.

Frontend: Dashboard - Besteld action but.details: Green 'Besteld' button in widget marks material as ordered. Material disappears from widget after clicking.
